tasks.short: Study product characteristics and set validation objectives.

steps.what: Study product characteristics and customer requirements
Flag blank fields in stored requirements
Determine validation objectives and standards
Sign the validation objectives for this version
File the signed validation objectives
outputs: filed copy of signed validation objectives v1

tasks.design: The engineer studies the product file in {DOCS} and sets the objectives. A job only lists blank requirement fields. The engineer signs the objectives, and a later job files that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements and product notes sat in separate files, so the objective was rewritten for every study.
tasks.enabler_now: The requirement record already has fields a blank check can read.
tasks.still_hard: A customer can add a standard that is not in the stored file.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides which objective and which standard apply.

ambition.what: Set objectives when a requirement field is filled, without retyping the product file.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the objective, not on hunting blank fields.

reach.task: Use the signed objectives on the next study

evidence.claim: Digest [S5] is cited for coded rule checks on records and plan reviews, so blank protocol fields are listed before the engineer decides.
The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.

assumptions: The product file can be read without a new store.
Configure that file before adding a new store.
unknowns: Which record holds the customer requirement.
Whether a second signature is required on an objective.
research_questions: How often a requirement arrives only on paper.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining study time is still the engineer's own reading.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes few requirements are already in fields. The high end assumes most requirements are already in fields. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze validation data against criteria and causes.

steps.what: Compare stored test rows with criteria limits
Analyze whether systems met validation criteria
Identify root causes of production problems
Sign the criteria and cause finding
File the signed criteria finding
outputs: filed copy of signed criteria finding v1

tasks.design: A job on {DATA_PLATFORM} compares stored test rows with the criteria limits. The engineer decides whether the systems met the criteria and what caused a production problem. A later job files the signed finding in {DOCS}. A model does not pass or fail a safety component.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test rows and limits were copied by hand before anyone could say the run had met the criteria.
tasks.enabler_now: The test record already stores the measurement and the limit.
tasks.still_hard: A new failure mode is not in the history, and the part may still need to be seen.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides the pass or fail and the cause.

ambition.what: Open a cause note the day a stored result sits outside its limit.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the cause, not on rebuilding the comparison.

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says test data and root-cause work can use a dashboard and statistics on recorded measurements, and the engineer still decides the cause.
Digest [S12] says safety components in road traffic, water, gas, heating, or electricity are high-risk, so a pass or fail on such a component stays with the engineer.
Digest [S20] says the institution asked for a paper to be withdrawn because it had no confidence in the data, so a generated number is not a record.

assumptions: Criteria limits are stored next to the test rows.
Configure the existing test record before a new store.
unknowns: Whether every test writes a row.
Who else must sign a failed criterion.
research_questions: Which criteria belong to a safety component.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining analysis time is still the engineer's judgement.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes limits are missing for many tests. The high end assumes limits are stored for most tests. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop validation plans, diagrams, cases, and procedures.

steps.what: Develop validation master plans and test cases
Draw process flow diagrams from the plan
Draft standard operating procedures from rows

loop.purpose: Draft operating procedures from the engineer's outline and stored protocol rows.
loop.input: The outline and stored rows, each with an identifier.
loop.output: Procedure text in which every number cites a stored row.
loop.check: Every number and name matches a stored row.
loop.stop: Stop when a number has no stored row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A blank template cannot follow the outline the engineer wrote.

steps.what: Check procedure numbers against source rows
Sign the validation plan and procedures
File the signed validation plan
outputs: filed copy of signed validation plan v1

tasks.design: The engineer develops the master plan, the test cases, and the flow diagram in {DOCS}. A bounded draft writes operating procedures only from that outline and stored rows, and it stops when a number has no row. The engineer signs the plan, and a later job files that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans and procedures were rewritten from memory, and figures were easy to detach from the source row.
tasks.enabler_now: Approved protocol rows can be cited by identifier.
tasks.still_hard: A new process has no stored row, and the diagram still needs the engineer's layout.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer owns the plan and will not sign a number that has no row.

ambition.what: Issue a plan when the objectives are signed, without retyping stored protocol rows.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the plan and the diagram, not on retyping stored sentences.

reach.learn: Which rows the procedures may cite

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says an artefact generator fills templates from records, a model may draft prose, every number must trace to a record, and the engineer signs.
Digest [S20] says the institution asked for a paper to be withdrawn because it had no confidence in the data, so a generated number is not a record.
The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.

assumptions: Stored protocol rows are the only numeric source.
Configure the existing document store before a new one.
unknowns: Who maintains the protocol row list.
Whether a diagram needs a controlled drawing number.
research_questions: How often a procedure cites a row that later changes.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining planning time is still the engineer's design.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes few protocol rows are stored. The high end assumes most procedure numbers already have rows. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare validation reports from qualification test results.

steps.what: Assemble qualification test result rows
Review procedures and protocols behind results
Draft detailed reports from result rows

loop.purpose: Draft the report from stored qualification results and the engineer's outline.
loop.input: Stored result rows and the outline.
loop.output: Report prose in which every figure cites a result row.
loop.check: Every figure matches a stored result row.
loop.stop: Stop when a figure has no result row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot write the design statement the engineer still has to make.

steps.what: Prepare design statements for the report
Sign the detailed validation report
File the signed validation report
outputs: filed copy of signed validation report v1

tasks.design: A job assembles qualification results in {DATA_PLATFORM}. A bounded draft writes the report only from those rows and stops when a figure has no row. The engineer prepares the design statements, signs the report in {DOCS}, and a later job files that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were rebuilt from printed results, and a figure could enter with no result row.
tasks.enabler_now: Qualification results are already stored as rows.
tasks.still_hard: A design statement still needs the engineer's judgement of the protocol.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides what the results mean and signs only figures that trace.

ambition.what: Issue the report the day the qualification rows are complete.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the design statement, not on copying result tables.

reach.learn: Which result rows the report may cite

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says an artefact generator fills templates from records, a model may draft prose, every number must trace to a record, and the engineer signs.
Digest [S20] says the institution asked for a paper to be withdrawn because it had no confidence in the data, so a generated number is not a record.

assumptions: Every report figure must trace to a result row.
Configure the existing result store before a new one.
unknowns: Whether a customer must receive the report.
research_questions: How often a result row is corrected after the draft.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining review time is still the engineer's reading of the protocol.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes results arrive as paper. The high end assumes results are already stored as rows. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The validation engineer spends the week on the test, the deviation, and the signed decision. Filing a signed record can move. A model does not release a protocol or change a live test station.
reach: Quality staff collect a sample only from the list the engineer signed.
A department starts a test only after the signed schedule is filed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a protocol figure that has no source row.
Leave equipment, sampling, and agency contact as their own work.
role.ambitious_version: A signed protocol or report can be filed the same day, and the engineer still releases it.
